Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Thursday
Markets.summary: Indian equities extended their losing streak to a seventh consecutive session, with the Sensex falling 326 points and the Nifty dropping to 24,078 amid rising oil prices and US-Iran tensions. Analysts note that the 24,000 to 24,050 range serves as a crucial support level as weak market breadth favors the bears.

Markets.title: Estee Lauder bets on fragrances and skincare to deliver strong annual profit
Markets.summary: Estee Lauder projects annual profits that will exceed Wall Street expectations, driven largely by its luxury fragrance brands like Tom Ford and Le Labo. The company expects strong demand from young, affluent consumers as it expands its brand presence in China and international markets.

Markets.title: Sebi flags manipulative trades during CAS on Sensex expiry day, fines two entities
Markets.summary: Sebi issued an interim order against Copthall Mauritius and Mansi Share and Stock Broking for manipulative trading during the August 13, 2026, Closing Auction Session. The regulator impounded Rs 3.67 crore in alleged wrongful gains from these two entities.

Markets.title: Goldman Sachs backs D-street debutante Shiprocket, buys over 40 lakh shares
Markets.summary: Logistics company Shiprocket debuted on the NSE at a 35% premium of ₹131 and closed at ₹143.10. Following the listing, Goldman Sachs India EQ Portfolio purchased 40.24 lakh shares.

Markets.title: BSE looks to launch MSCI-linked futures and options in India
Markets.summary: BSE has partnered with MSCI to explore launching index-linked futures and options contracts in India, pending regulatory approval. This initiative aims to expand BSE's derivatives offerings and provide investors with new tools to hedge their India exposure.

Markets.title: Moderna shares soar 159% in a day after cancer vaccine succeeds in late-stage trial
Markets.summary: Moderna shares surged 159% in a single day after its personalized mRNA cancer vaccine, combined with Keytruda, successfully reduced melanoma recurrence in a late-stage trial. This marks the first successful late-stage trial for an mRNA cancer vaccine, boosting the company's growth prospects beyond COVID-19 vaccines.

Geo-Political.title: Israel confirms soldiers fired at car in which Hind Rajab was killed and opens criminal investigation
Geo-Political.summary: Israel has launched a criminal investigation after confirming its soldiers fired at the car carrying five-year-old Hind Rajab in Gaza. Rajab initially survived the shooting and pleaded for help, but she and six of her relatives were later found dead.

Geo-Political.title: Sacked Ukrainian defence minister calls for presidential election
Geo-Political.summary: Ukraine's former defense minister has called for a presidential election despite ongoing martial law. Ukrainian law currently suspends national elections due to the martial law in place since February 2022.

Geo-Political.title: Trump pauses new tariffs on Canada for three days, saying deal close
Geo-Political.summary: President Trump delayed planned tariffs on Canadian goods for three days. He stated that the two nations are close to finalizing an agreement to prevent the import taxes.

Geo-Political.title: Israel opens up bids for highly-sensitive West Bank settlement project
Geo-Political.summary: Israel is accepting bids for a controversial housing project east of Jerusalem in the occupied West Bank. This development plan has faced international condemnation because it would divide the West Bank into two parts.

Geo-Political.title: South Korea shortens war games with US, citing Washington request
Geo-Political.summary: South Korea has shortened its joint military exercises with the United States. This reduction follows a request from Washington after President Trump announced plans to curtail these drills to maintain his relationship with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un.

Geo-Political.title: Ukrainian man arrested in Croatia over Nord Stream pipeline blasts
Geo-Political.summary: A Ukrainian man has been arrested in Croatia for allegedly participating in the 2022 Nord Stream pipeline bombings. He is suspected of being one of the scuba divers who planted explosives on the underwater pipelines.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: A digital creator discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result by ChatGPT without paying for advertising. This experiment highlights the shift in organic traffic from traditional search engine optimization to AI-driven optimization.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: The digital landscape of 2025 requires content creators to use artificial intelligence to stay competitive. This guide highlights the top 10 AI tools designed to simplify and revolutionize the content creation process.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire is a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their work.

AI & Tech.summary: This article highlights the top 10 artificial intelligence tools of 2023 that drive innovation across industries. These advanced applications are designed to automate repetitive tasks, improve workflows, and increase overall productivity.

AI & Tech.summary: This article explores the top ten AI content generator and writer tools available in 2022 to help users create effective and engaging material. It highlights the benefits of using these technologies while noting that choosing the right tool can be challenging due to the many options on the market.

AI & Tech.summary: This beginner's guide explains how to use the CJ Affiliate network to earn money online. It also highlights top CJ affiliate programs and alternative platforms for new users.

Data & Insights.title: RBI’s $50 billion boost may not be enough to lift the rupee | Here's why
Data & Insights.summary: India expects a $50 billion balance-of-payments surplus in fiscal year 2027, but experts warn it may not strengthen the rupee. The currency's actual impact depends on whether these capital inflows enter the market or are absorbed as foreign exchange reserves by the central bank.

Data & Insights.title: RBI's rate-setting panel hints at future policy tightening if inflation persists
Data & Insights.summary: Reserve Bank of India Governor Malhotra stated that the central bank requires clear evidence of persistent inflation before adjusting monetary policy. Consequently, the rate-setting panel has signaled potential policy tightening if elevated price pressures continue.

Data & Insights.title: Who pays, who profits — Unpacking the economics of India's toll landscape, in charts
Data & Insights.summary: Data from the Indian Highway Management Company shows that high-traffic routes and shifting private investments are driving India's highway revenue. Additionally, the introduction of the FASTag annual pass is playing a major role in shaping the country's toll collection economics.

Data & Insights.title: Ind-Ra raises India’s FY27 GDP growth estimate to 6.8%
Data & Insights.summary: India Ratings and Research (Ind-Ra) has increased India's fiscal year 2027 GDP growth estimate to 6.8%. However, the agency warns that the West Asia war, high inflation, currency depreciation, and weak capital expenditure pose downside risks to this outlook.

Data & Insights.title: Govt frontloads farm spending as El Nino risks cloud rural outlook
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government is accelerating agricultural spending and fertilizer subsidies to protect rural incomes. This strategy aims to counteract the negative economic impacts of El Nino and a weak monsoon on the rural economy.

Data & Insights.title: $57 billion pours in, another $30 billion may follow: Indian economy eyes massive $50 billion surplus
Data & Insights.summary: SBI Research forecasts a $50 billion balance of payments surplus for India in fiscal year 2027. This growth will be driven by strong foreign currency inflows.

India.title: Fake, Expired Medicines Worth Rs 5 Crore Seized Repacking Unit In Bengaluru
India.summary: Bengaluru authorities seized fake and expired medicines worth Rs 5 crore from a repacking unit. The operators allegedly procured cheap drugs from other states, filled them into new vials, and relabelled them as expensive multinational and imported brands.

India.title: Drugs Hidden In Car Stereo In Kerala, Women And Child Used As Cover
India.summary: Kerala's Excise Enforcement and Anti-Narcotic Special Squad intercepted a car in Balaramapuram carrying MDMA from Bengaluru. The suspects concealed the drugs inside a car stereo and used women and a child as a cover.

India.title: Charanjit Channi Skips Key Congress Meet, Says Busy With Exam Preparation
India.summary: Charanjit Channi skipped a crucial Congress Working Committee meeting. He stated that he needed to focus on preparing for his upcoming Public Administration examination at Panjab University.

India.title: Satyendar Jain Arrest Deja Vu for AAP Ahead Of Punjab Polls
India.summary: In 2022, Satyendar Jain was arrested by the Enforcement Directorate while handling AAP's campaign in Himachal Pradesh.

General.title: Track defect found on approach to site of Lewes derailment, initial report says
General.summary: An initial RAIB investigation report revealed a track defect near the site of the Lewes derailment. Investigators described the issue as an "irregularity" found on the approach to the location.

General.title: Thunderstorm warnings issued for parts of UK with flash flooding expected
General.summary: Warnings for northern England, eastern Scotland and Northern Ireland will come into force later on Wednesday.

General.title: Israel confirms soldiers fired at car in which Hind Rajab was killed and opens criminal investigation
General.summary: Israel has opened a criminal investigation and confirmed its soldiers fired at the car carrying five-year-old Hind Rajab in Gaza. Rajab initially survived the shooting and pleaded for help, but she and six of her relatives were later found dead.

General.title: Salmonella outbreak: What we know so far
General.summary: An outbreak of salmonella infections has made hundreds of people sick. Health officials linked the outbreak to imported eggs.

General.title: Tenders open for highly-sensitive West Bank settlement project, Israel announces
General.summary: Israel has opened tenders for a controversial settlement project east of Jerusalem. The planned construction would divide the occupied West Bank into two parts and has faced long-standing international condemnation.

General.title: 'Incredible': SpaceX rocket spotted off Christmas Island coast
General.summary: Christmas Island residents spotted a SpaceX rocket being towed off their coast after it went missing following a July launch from Texas. The rocket had previously crashed into the Indian Ocean and had not been seen since.
